rows.en: Hikari...! Are you okay to be up already!?
Are you okay to be up already!?
Yeah, well enough to move around, anyway.
That's what I expect from you! You bounce back fast!
I've already looked over the facilities. There's a ton of devices and gear here I've never seen.
Did all that get pulled into the base too?
Yeah, but a lot of it's broken.
Stuff like this, and...
Stuff like this...
Stuff like this, for example.
I see... But if that's all that's wrong, it should run once it's repaired.
Outside the Briefing Room, there's a place that's like a big junk heap.
If we dig around there, we might turn up more useful stuff.
Hikari, do you have a moment?
We were just discussing how to rescue Mebius...
I was hoping you might have some kind of lead...
A lead...
Anything at all. Please, tell us.
Come to think of it, the enemy reinforcements called themselves the something-or-other Army...
I think it was... Nega...
Negataros!?
That's it.
I see. Negataros, and Bogal...
And the Weather Dopant ruling over them... Now we're getting a picture of the enemy's organization.
All right, everyone. Let's go out exploring again.
Sitting here talking isn't gonna find Mebius... Right?
Let me go. This is my responsibility. It's because of my own selfish actions that...
This is my responsibility. It's because of my own selfish actions that...
Hikari! If you go now, you'll only end up repeating the same mistake.
If you go now, you'll only end up repeating the same mistake!
Don't you understand that?
...You're right. I'm sorry.
I'll take charge of maintaining the base. I'll support all of you from here.
Right. That's reassuring.
I'm counting on you to save Mebius.
I was just picking out some items that might come in handy.
What...? You have a Denden Memory? Let me take a look at it.
Let me take a look at it.
{8074} handed the Denden Memory to Hikari.
Oh... This is... the Denden Memory for the Denden Sensor.
I see, so this was for the Denden Sensor.
Yes. I found the main unit a little while ago. With this, I might be able to fix it.
So the Memory Gadgets got pulled in too. How very interesting.
You know about it?
Of course.
It's a Memory Gadget that makes hidden things visible. It's built from a combination of sensors.
Exactly. You certainly know your stuff.
...If you ask me, Hikari, you're the one who knows a lot.
Believe it or not, I was a Space Science Technology Bureau researcher in the Land of Light.
It may be technology from another world, but the basic design philosophy has a lot in common.
As long as you don't forget that, you can understand how most things work.
I see... You're absolutely right. You surprise me, Hikari.
Right! Let's get started on the repairs.
Hikari began repairing the Denden Sensor. It looks like it will take a while to finish.
Hmph. So this is your little hideout, huh.
Ankh!!
You're still tagging along?
You're just here to collect medals, right?
Yeah. But there are more strong foes here than I figured. Way I see it, only you lot can take 'em on.
From what I've seen, you lot are about the only ones who can stand up to them.
So I'll be sticking with you too.
If you wanted to join us, you could've just said so.
D-Don't get the wrong idea. I just want to collect medals more efficiently.
Yeah, yeah.
Tch. Then let's hurry up and grab those medals. We'll explore deeper in to learn about the enemy!
If we want to learn even a little about the enemy, we need to explore deeper in.
Hikari!! Is the Denden Sensor ready?
What is it? What's the rush...
We need it right now!! To beat the Weather Dopant!
Heh... Relax, it's already done. Take it!!
Seriously!! You're the best!!
Take it!
Obtained the "Denden Sensor".
Press that switch and you can search out hidden enemies. Good luck out there!
Yeah, leave it to me!!
All right! This time, we're not letting him get away!!
Wait a moment! Before that, there's something I need to talk about.
Den-O...
What?
